name: security_patch_gate
description: Load one reported security finding, auto-patch the vulnerable source file if approved, and write a patch report. The build's generated verification gate runs the application's own unit test suite (npm test) as the blocking check that the fix is both correct and non-regressive.

settings.action: Read examples/security_patch_gate/config/finding.json. Set slots: finding_id, repo, file, function, severity, title, description, remediation_hint, approved_for_auto_patch.

Open examples/security_patch_gate/<file slot>. Apply minimal fix for the vulnerability per description/remediation_hint; do not restructure unrelated code. Save in place. Set patch_summary slot: short description of exact change made.
Write examples/security_patch_gate/patch-report-<today, YYYY-MM-DD>.json with finding_id, patched file, patch_summary, status: 'patched'.
Write examples/security_patch_gate/patch-abort-<today, YYYY-MM-DD>.json with finding_id, status: 'aborted', reason: 'not approved_for_auto_patch'.

variables.description: Flag from the finding JSON indicating whether the security finding is approved for automatic patching.
